blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for instruction-based image editing and as reward signals for model training. However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality.
To address this challenge, we introduce EditJudgeBias, a counterfactual benchmark with verified quality preservation, comprising 1,196 real editing samples and 13 cues injected across four evaluation sites. We verify quality preservation for the requested edit using calibrated multimodal validators, controls, and human inspection. We then audit five MLLM judges along three complementary dimensions: invariance to quality-preserving cues, agreement with human judgments, and stability of pairwise preferences. Importantly, observed shifts are evaluated against each judge’s own zero-dose and re-query noise floors rather than against zero.
Experiments show that quality-preserving cues move every judge beyond its own noise. Fabricated majority opinions increase ratings, irrelevant visual elements cause larger shifts than whole-image manipulations, and swapping candidate order reverses up to 60.9% of pairwise decisions. Edit-region cues also tend to reduce human agreement. The three measures characterize judges differently, showing that robustness cannot be captured by a single metric.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)被越来越多地用作基于教学的图像编辑的自动判断器和模型培训的奖励信号. 然而,对这些法官是否受到与编辑质量无关的提示的影响进行系统审计具有挑战性,因为视觉干预本身可能改变所评价的质量。 因此,只有在对干预进行核查以保持基本的编辑质量时,判决的转变才能归因于偏见。
为了应对这一挑战,我们采用了Edit JudgeBias,这是一个经核实的质量保存的反事实基准,包括1 196个真实的编辑样本和在四个评价站点注入的13个提示。 我们使用校准的多式验证器、控制和人员检查,对要求编辑的质量进行核查。 然后,我们从三个相辅相成的方面对5名劳动和劳动管理法官进行了审计:对保留质量的暗示的偏差、与人类的判断一致以及双向偏好的稳定。 重要的是,所观察到的转变是根据每个法官自己的零剂量和再平压噪音底数而不是零值来评价的。
实验显示 保持质量的提示 使每个法官都超越了自己的噪音 虚构的多数派意见会提高收视率,无关的视觉元素导致比全图像操控更大的转变,并互换候选人订单会逆转高达60.9%的对等决定. 编辑区域提示也往往会减少人类的共识. 这三项措施对法官的定性不同,表明不能用单一的衡量标准来衡量其稳健性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in unified multimodal models have substantially improved instruction-based image editing ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . Evaluating these models requires judging instruction adherence, preservation of unrelated content, and visual quality. Because human evaluation is costly, benchmarks increasingly use multimodal models as automated judges ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ) , while dedicated evaluators are trained on human preferences ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ) . These judges are also used for output selection and reinforcement learning ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , making their sensitivity to the evaluation procedure consequential. Do they measure the edit, or do quality-preserving cues move their decisions?
blocks.zh: 统一多模式的最新进展大大改进了基于教学的图像编辑工作(Deng等,2025;Xie等,2025;Diao等,2026;Fu等,2026)。 评估这些模型需要判断是否遵守指令、保存不相关内容和视觉质量。 由于人的评价费用昂贵,基准越来越多地使用多模式模式作为自动化法官(赵等,2025;吴等,2025a),而专职评价人员则接受关于人类偏好的培训(吴等,2026;姬等,2026)。 这些法官还被用于产出选择和强化学习(Luo等,2026年),使他们对评价程序的敏感性随之而来。 是测量编辑呢?还是保存质量的提示会移动他们的判断呢?

blocks.en: Agreement with human judgments provides only a partial view of judge reliability ( Song et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) . A judge may align well with humans on the original benchmark yet change its decision when the same edit is presented differently. Attributing an output to a particular model or claiming that other evaluators prefer it, for example, provides no new evidence about whether the instruction was followed. Visual cues are harder to test because the intervention itself may affect the edit: a region annotation can obscure an object, and a brightness adjustment can change an attribute requested by the instruction. Figure 1 illustrates why preservation has to be checked as part of the audit.
blocks.zh: 与人类判决的协议只提供了法官可靠性的部分观点(Song等,2025;Xu等,2025b.)。 法官可能与人类在原始基准上保持一致,但当同一编辑方式不同时,法官会改变其决定。 例如,将产出归于某一特定模式或声称其他评价人员更喜欢该模式,没有就是否遵循该指示提供新的证据。 视觉提示更难测试,因为干预本身可能影响编辑:一个区域注释可以遮蔽一个对象,而亮度调整可以改变指令所要求的属性. 图1说明了为什么必须在审计中检查保全。

blocks.en: We introduce EditJudgeBias , a counterfactual benchmark for testing these sensitivities under controlled interventions. It contains 1,196 real editing triplets drawn from five public benchmarks and three independent content pools, with thirteen cues inserted at four points in the evaluation pipeline: the display protocol, judge prompt, image pixels, and edited content. Each sample is judged both with and without the cue. We collect three 1–10 rubric ratings in the scoring setting and preferences between two edits of the same request in the pairwise setting. Image-side cues are checked with calibrated validators and human annotations, and observed shifts are interpreted relative to each judge’s sham and re-query variability.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Edit JudgeBias,这是对照控制干预措施测试这些敏感性的反事实基准。 它包含1,196个真实的编辑三重奏取自5个公共基准和3个独立内容池,在评价管道的4个点上插入了13个提示:显示协议、法官即时、图像像素和编辑内容。 每个样本都经过判断,无论有没有提示。 我们在评分设置中收集了3个1-10分的评分,并在对等设置中同一请求的两个编辑之间收集了偏好。 用校正校正的校正器和人文说明来检查图像侧道,

blocks.en: Quality-preserving cues systematically affect all five judges beyond their own response noise. In scoring, a fabricated majority opinion raises all three ratings across all judges, while a small sticker causes larger shifts than any whole-image manipulation. These effects also extend to human agreement: when a cue significantly changes agreement, it almost always reduces it, particularly for cues involving the edit region. In pairwise evaluation, simply swapping the display order reverses up to 60.9% of decisions, far exceeding the 1.0 to 10.5% reversal rate under repeated queries. Moreover, the judges behave differently across invariance, agreement, and stability, suggesting that no single robustness measure captures all failure modes.
blocks.zh: 保持质量的提示系统地影响着所有5位评委,超出了他们自己的反应噪音. 在评分中,一成不变的多数意见提升了所有评委的三分评分,而一分小贴纸导致的变动比任何一成不变的画面操纵都大. 这些影响也延伸到人类协议:当一个提示显著地改变协议时,它几乎总是会减少,特别是对于涉及编辑区域的提示. 在对等评价中,简单地将显示单互换最多可折回60.9%的决定,远远超过了重复询问中1.0到10.5%的倒置率. 此外,法官们在变化、同意和稳定方面的行为也不同,这表明,没有任何单一的强健性衡量标准能够涵盖所有失败模式。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Judges for instruction-based image editing
blocks.zh: 2.1 法官进行基于教学的图像编辑

blocks.en: Instruction-based image editing ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) is commonly evaluated on benchmarks that pair edited images with human labels ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Ku et al., 2024b ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Ji et al., 2026 ) . VIEScore helped establish rubric-prompted MLLM scoring for this setting ( Ku et al., 2024a ) , an approach now used in leaderboards ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Ye et al., 2025b ) , agentic evaluators ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and open judges ( Lee et al., 2024 ) . A parallel line of work trains editing-specific reward models against human preferences and uses them for online reinforcement learning ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Other studies compare judges with human labels through factor-level agreement ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , expert mean-opinion scores and intermediate-layer probing ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , or dedicated preference suites ( Bai et al., 2026 ) .

VIEScore帮助为这一设定设定了由Rub-pointed MLLM评分(Ku等人,2024年a),这一方法现在被用于领导板(Liu等人,2025年a); Ye等,2025b.),代理评审员(Wang等,2025a.)和公开评审员(Lee等,2024. 并行的工作线 列车针对人类偏好进行编辑的特有奖励模式,并用于在线强化学习(Luo等,2026;Zhao等,2026;Chen等,2026a;Xu等,2026a; 王等, 2025b. blocks.en: Sensitivity to quality-preserving changes in evaluation has received much less attention. EditReward reports a position effect for one judge in an appendix ( Wu et al., 2026 ) ; GEditBench v2 randomizes presentation order without quantifying the resulting position bias ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) ; and EdiVal-Agent catalogs failure modes of zero-shot judges without controlled interventions ( Chen et al., 2026c ) . They leave open whether presentation changes that preserve the underlying edit can move judge decisions beyond ordinary response variability. The issue also matters when judges are used as reward models, since optimization can amplify exploitable shortcuts ( Gao et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 对评价中保持质量变化的敏感性受到的关注要少得多。 Edition Reward在附录(Wu等,2026年)中报告对一名法官的职位影响;Gedit Bench v2在不量化所造成职位偏差的情况下随机排列呈现顺序(Jiang等,2026年;EdiVal-Agent编目中零射出法官的故障模式没有控制干预(Chen等,2026年c). 他们对保留了基础编辑的演示文稿变化能否将判断决定移出普通响应可变性之外,没有定论. 当法官被用作奖励模式时,这个问题也很重要,因为优化可以扩大可开发的捷径(Gao等,2023年)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Biases in MLLM-as-a-judge
blocks.zh: 2.2 作为法官的《反洗钱法》中的偏见

blocks.en: Text-only judges are known to exhibit position, verbosity, and self-preference biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Saito et al., 2023 ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ) . CALM systematically studies twelve such biases using robustness and consistency measures ( Ye et al., 2025a ) . Recent work also shows that high consistency across repeated evaluations can coexist with substantial position bias ( Norman et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) , motivating construct validity as a framework for evaluating judges ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 已知只有文字法官才能显示位置、动词和自我偏好(郑等,2023;王等,2024;斋藤等,2023;Paniksery等,2024)。 CALM利用稳健性和一致性措施系统研究了12起此类偏见(Ye等人,2025年a)。 最近的工作还表明,反复进行的评价具有高度的一致性,可与实质性的立场偏见并存(Norman等人,2026年;Xu等人,2026年b),这促使人们将构建有效性作为评价法官的框架(Chen等人,2026年b) 。

blocks.en:
Multimodal judges face additional biases arising from visual inputs. In text-to-image (T2I) evaluation, FRAME studies eight visual manipulations and shows that they can inflate judge scores ( Hwang et al., 2025 ) . Other studies investigate adversarial perturbations ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , preference bias, and prototypicality bias ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Roy et al., 2026 ) . In visual question answering and image captioning, MM-JudgeBias evaluates nine types of perturbations across 26 MLLMs ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , while other studies examine informativeness, perceptual, model-preference, and order biases ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Park et al., 2026 ; Koyama et al., 2026 ; Ianaro et al., 2026 ) .
However, these audits focus on generated images, answers, or captions rather than instruction-based image editing. Evaluating an edit requires assessing whether the edited image faithfully follows the instruction given the source image, which introduces editing-specific factors such as the edit’s location and extent. Cues tied to the edit region therefore remain largely unexplored in existing bias audits.
blocks.zh:
多式联运法官面临视觉投入带来的额外偏见。 在文字对图像(T2I)评价中,FRAME研究了8个视觉操纵,并显示它们可以提升评分(Hwang等,2025.). 其他研究调查了对抗性扰动(Wang等,2026年),偏好偏好,和原型偏好(Chen等,2025年;Roy等,2026年). 在视觉问题回答和图像字幕方面,MM-JudgeBias评价了26个MLLMs(Lee等,2026年)的9个类型的扰动,而其他研究则研究了信息性、观念、模式偏好和秩序偏好(Zou等,2026年;Park等,2026年;Koyama等,2026年;Ianaro等,2026年)。
然而,这些审计侧重于生成的图像、答案或标题,而不是基于指令的图像编辑。 评价编辑需要评估编辑图像是否忠实地遵循给定的源图像的指令,该指令引入了编辑特定因素,如编辑位置和范围等. 因此,与编辑区域挂钩的Cues基本上仍未在现有的偏向性审计中得到探讨。

blocks.en: 2.3 Quality verification of injected cues
blocks.zh: 2.3 注射提示的质量核查

blocks.en: Perturbation-based audits are interpretable only when the intervention leaves the evaluated construct unchanged; otherwise, a changed score may reflect a real degradation rather than evaluator bias. CheckList formalizes this as an invariance test ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) . For LLM judges, Chen et al. (2026b) report both invariance under construct-preserving edits and sensitivity to construct-changing ones, while Perturbation CheckLists deliberately degrade outputs to test the latter ( Sai et al., 2021 ) . Preservation is handled less uniformly elsewhere: it may be assumed ( Vu et al., 2022 ) , checked on a small manual sample ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , left unverified for rewritten variants ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , or avoided by collecting human ratings for both versions ( Huang and Baldwin, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 只有在干预措施使被评价的结构保持不变时,才能解释基于扰动的审计;否则,改变的分数可能反映真正的退化,而不是评价者的偏见。 CheckList将这正式确定为一种无变化测试(Ribeiro等,2020年). 对于法学硕士, Chen等人(2026年b)报告在保留构造编辑时的偏差和改变构造编辑时的敏感度,而Perturbation CheckLists则故意降低输出来测试后者(Sai等人,2021年)。 保存工作在别处的处理不太统一:可以假定(Vu等,2022年),在小型人工样本上检查(Wu等,2025年b),对重写变体(Liu等,2025年b)留置未核实,或者通过收集人类对两种版本的评分来避免(Huang和Baldwin,2023年).

blocks.en:
Multimodal audits make different choices as well. FRAME does not verify that its manipulations are harmless and lists semantic-preserving perturbations as future work ( Hwang et al., 2025 ) ; MM-JudgeBias treats its composed perturbations as preservation-preserving ( Lee et al., 2026 ) ; and Agarwal et al. (2026) verify 480 image–text items with three annotators each. Pixel or embedding similarity ( Wang et al., 2004 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ; Hessel et al., 2021 ) measures how much an image changes, but not whether the edited output still satisfies its instruction. Even near-invisible overlaid text can alter model behavior ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) .
We evaluate preservation relative to the source image and instruction, using calibrated validators and human checks for every image-side cue.
blocks.zh:
多式联运审计也作出不同的选择。 FRAME没有证实其操纵是无害的,并将语义保留扰动列为未来工作(Hwang等人,2025年);MM-Judge Bias将其构成的扰动视为保留扰动(Lee等人,2026年;Agarwal等人,2026年)将480个图像-文本项目分别用3个注释器验证。 像素或嵌入相似性(Wang等,2004;Zhang等,2018;Hessel等,2021)测量一幅图像的改变程度,但不测量所编辑的输出是否仍然满足了它的指令. 即使是近于隐形的上盖文字也能改变模型行为(Cheng等,2024.).
我们利用校正验证器和对每个图像侧提示进行人机检查,评估与源头图像和指示有关的保存情况。

blocks.en: We build EditJudgeBias from five published image-editing benchmarks with human supervision: I2EBench ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , MagicBrush ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , ImagenHub ( Ku et al., 2024b ) , GenAI-Bench ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) , and EBench-18K ( Xu et al., 2025a ) . Although these are five benchmarks, they span only three independent content pools because the rated ImagenHub images are drawn from the MagicBrush development set and most GenAI-Bench editing prompts come from the same pool. Their annotations provide the supervision needed for different parts of the audit, including per-dimension mean-opinion scores, absolute ratings, pairwise preferences, and gold edits (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: We introduce 13 controlled cues into the selected editing samples, grouped by where they enter the judging pipeline: protocol, prompt, pixel, or content as shown in Figure 3 . This grouping identifies each intervention’s entry point and helps localize where an observed effect may arise. Protocol and prompt cues introduce no visual changes and extend biases studied in text-only evaluation ( Ye et al., 2025a ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ) . Pixel cues modify image pixels through photometric, framing, or localized overlay operations ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . Content cues are defined relative to the edit region and are specific to image-editing evaluation. Exact operators and doses are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en:
For content cues, we use the benchmark-provided source mask when available; otherwise, we estimate the edit region as the largest connected component of the thresholded difference between the source and edited images.
We apply pixel and content cues deterministically to the edited image, without re-rendering the underlying edit. We also include sham , a zero-dose control that provides the judge-specific sham floor used to contextualize cue-induced shifts. Our pixel-level cues partially overlap with those studied in FRAME and MM-JudgeBias ( Hwang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 3.4 Quality-Preservation Verification

blocks.en: Attributing a cue-induced judgment shift to bias requires establishing that the cue preserves underlying editing quality, i.e., Q ⁡ ( T ⁡ ( x ) ) = Q ⁡ ( x ) Q(T(x))=Q(x) . Without this condition, the shift could reflect a genuine change in quality rather than bias. We assess preservation using three complementary sources of evidence: image similarity, calibrated MLLM validators, and human checks.

blocks.en: For every cued image, we report whole-image SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) against its un-cued counterpart. For content-site cues, SSIM also captures the added overlay itself and therefore provides only a conservative measure of preservation. We use SSIM as a descriptive measure rather than a filtering criterion.

blocks.en: We use MLLM validators to determine whether a cue changes the underlying edit. To check that they distinguish preserved edits from genuine quality changes, we calibrate them in both directions. The zero-dose sham condition measures each validator’s false-positive rate, while positive controls measure its sensitivity to known quality changes. For the positive controls, we revert the edit region toward the source image at three strengths and separately blur the edit region. These interventions provide known violations of preservation without requiring human ground truth.

The third validator, from a model family absent from the judge panel, is designed to provide an independent cross-check.

We also assess preservation for all ten image-side cues through human annotation, using 30 examples per cue. The first set contains 150 examples covering five pixel-site cues. Annotators label whether each cue changes the underlying edit as No, Slightly, or Yes. Under the pre-defined criterion, only Yes counts as a preservation failure. Two annotators work independently, with the second annotating a 60-item subset of the blinded set.

blocks.en: 5.1 Invariance under Quality-Preserving Cues

blocks.en: Quality-preserving cues can shift ratings beyond judge-specific response noise. Excluding inset ‡ , half of the instruction-adherence cells in Table 1 clear both the sham and retest floors; the corresponding counts are 34 of 55 for editing quality and 32 of 55 for detail preservation. The effects are not uniform across cues: bandwagon clears both floors for most judge–dimension combinations, whereas saturation never does. Despite covering at most 4% of the frame, the sticker produces larger rating changes than any pixel-site cue in every judge–dimension cell.
blocks.zh: 保质提示可以改变评分,超越判断特定的反应噪音. 表1中一半的指令遵守单元格清清楚楚地层和再测试地层,不包括内置值;相应的数字是编辑质量为55分之34,细节保存为55分之32。 效果并不是一成不变的:对大多数法官-配位组合来说,波德瓦贡可以清空两层楼,而饱和则永远不会。 尽管贴纸最多覆盖了框架的4%,但比起每个判事-dimension细胞中的任何像素-site提示,标签的评级变化都更大。

blocks.en: The noise-floor criterion and the signed-shift test capture different properties of the response. A cell that does not clear both noise floors can still exhibit a significant signed shift: the former asks whether the magnitude of change exceeds response variability, whereas the latter tests whether paired changes show a consistent direction. A gray cell in Table 1 should therefore not be read as evidence of no directional effect.
blocks.zh: 噪声-地板标准和签名-转接测试捕捉到反应的不同属性. 一个没有清除两层噪声的单元格仍然可以显示出一个显著的被签名的转变:前者询问变化的大小是否超过响应可变性,而后者则测试成对变化是否显示一致的方向. 因此,表1中的灰色单元格不应被理解为没有方向效应的证据。

blocks.en: Several cues also shift pairwise preferences, showing that cue sensitivity is not specific to scalar scoring. Figure 4 a reports cue-induced changes in pairwise win rates. bandwagon increases the cued candidate’s win rate under every judge, while the sticker and text overlay tend to disadvantage. By contrast, saturation, the aesthetic filter, and the watermark have little effect on pairwise preferences. The effect of a quality-preserving cue therefore depends not only on the judge and cue, but on whether evaluation is elicited as an absolute score or a comparative preference.
blocks.zh: 几个提示也转出对等偏好,表明提示灵敏度不特指斯卡尔分. 图4 报告提示成对胜率的变化。 Bandwagon 提高每个法官候选人的胜利率, 相形之下,饱和,审美滤镜,和水印对对对偶偏好影响不大. 因此,保持质量提示的效果不仅取决于判断和提示,还取决于评价是作为绝对得分还是作为比较偏好而引出。

blocks.en: 5.2 Agreement with Human Judgments
blocks.zh: 5.2 与人类判决的协议

blocks.en:
Table 1 marks significant cue-induced changes in judge–human agreement, which are overwhelmingly negative.
Excluding the borderline INSET, 33 of the 34 significant changes are decreases. These decreases occur in 16 of 45 content-site comparisons, compared with 13 of 90 pixel-site and 4 of 30 prompt-site comparisons. This concentration among edit-region cues is descriptive rather than a formal comparison across sites, because the pixel and content groups each include comparisons against both SHAM and the original uncued images.
blocks.zh:
表1显示法官与人之间的协议发生了重大变化,结果绝大多数是负面的。
在34个重大变动中,33个减少,不包括国家教育与培训局的分界线。 这些减少发生在45个内容站点比较中的16个,而90个像素站点中的13个和30个快速站点比较中的4个。 这种在编辑区域提示中的集中是描述性的,而不是不同站点之间的正式比较,因为像素和内容组各包含与SHAM和原始未显示图像的比较.

blocks.en: The pairwise results provide a more direct example. When bandwagon assigns a fabricated majority to the candidate rejected by humans, agreement falls for every judge; reversing the fabricated majority instead increases agreement for all five. The same judge can appear more or less aligned with human preferences depending on a quality-irrelevant change in the evaluation context, illustrating why agreement alone is insufficient as a robustness measure.
blocks.zh: 双向结果提供了一个更直接的例子。 当乐队给被人类拒绝的候选人分配捏造的多数时,每位法官都会同意;相反,推翻捏造的多数会增加所有五名法官的协议。 同一法官似乎或多或少符合人类的偏好,这取决于评价背景下与质量无关的变化,说明为什么单凭协议不足以作为有力措施。

blocks.en: 5.3 Pairwise Stability under Display-Order Swaps
blocks.zh: 5.3 显示顺序相换下的对等稳定性

blocks.en:
Figure 4 b compares verdict-reversal rates under display-order swaps and identical re-queries, showing substantially higher rates under order swaps.
This separation holds across the primary judge panel and is especially pronounced for qwen3.5, for which 60.9% of order-swapped pairs reverse compared with 10.5% under identical re-query.
The replication judge shows the same qualitative separation between re-query variability and sensitivity to display order.
blocks.zh:
图4b比较了显示订单互换和相同重新订购情况下的判决折返率,显示订单互换情况下的折返率要高得多。
这种分离在初级法官小组之间进行,对qwen3.5特别明显,其中60.9%的分级配对倒置,而在相同的重排中则为10.5%。
复制裁判显示,再平时的可变性和对显示顺序的敏感性在质量上是相同的.

blocks.en: The two-order rule used by the MT-Bench ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) filters rather than resolves this instability: a winner is retained only when both presentation orders agree. This removes order-sensitive pairs at the cost of coverage, most sharply for qwen3.5. A lenient variant additionally retains the non-Tie choice when only one order returns Tie; pairs whose two orders select opposite winners remain unresolved. The Appendices E and F report the reconciliation analysis and the replication results, respectively.
blocks.zh: MT-Bench(Zheng等,2023年)使用的双序规则过滤而不是解决了这种不稳定性:只有在两种演示命令都同意时,才保留胜出者. 这可以以覆盖为代价去除对订单敏感的配对,对qwen3.5来说最尖锐. 宽放的变体在只有一个命令返回时还保留了非Tie选择 绑;对对对对对对对对对对的胜者 附录E和F分别报告了对账分析和复制结果。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Main results of the EditJudgeBias audit. (a) Pairwise preference shifts induced by quality-preserving cues. (b) Verdict reversal rates under display-order swaps, compared with identical re-queries. (c) Calibration of the preservation validators using controlled edit degradation and the zero-dose control. (d) Comparison of judges across invariance, agreement, and stability, showing that judge rankings differ across the three robustness measures.
blocks.zh: 图4:编辑法官比亚斯审计的主要结果。 (a) 由保质提示引起的对等偏好转移。 (b) 与相同的再排量相比,显示顺序互换的确定倒置率。 (c) 使用有控制的编辑降解和零剂量控制,校准保存验证器。 (d) 法官在变化、同意和稳定性方面的比较,显示法官在三项稳健措施方面的排名不同。

blocks.en: 5.4 Preservation Evidence
blocks.zh: 5.4 保全证据

blocks.en: Our preservation checks support treating most image-side cues as quality-preserving at the cue level. Figure 4 c shows the validators’ responses to controlled degradations. Among the ten image-side cues, only inset shows a significant departure from paired sham images. In the sham-controlled human annotation set, none of the five evaluated cues differs significantly from sham under the prespecified criterion.
blocks.zh: 我们的保存检查支持将大多数图像侧提示作为提示级别的质量保存. 图4c显示验证者对控制下退化的反应。 在10个图像侧提示中,只有内置显示显著偏离了配对的假图像. 在由假人控制的人类注释集中,五个被评价的提示中没有一个在预先规定的标准下与假人有显著区别.

blocks.en: The evidence for inset is less clear. Two validators flag it more often than sham , and a more inclusive post-hoc human criterion also identifies a difference. These signals do not justify treating the cue as uniformly quality-preserving, but neither do they overturn the preservation evidence for the remaining image-side interventions. We therefore treat inset as borderline, report its results separately, and exclude it from aggregate counts. This separation prevents the ambiguous cue from affecting the main aggregate conclusions while retaining its individual results for transparency.
blocks.zh: 内陷的证据不太明确. 两位验证者更经常地标出它, 这些信号不能作为统一保存质量的理由,但也不能推翻其余图像方面干预措施的保存证据。 因此,我们视其为边缘,分别报告结果,并将其排除在总数之外。 这种分离防止了模糊的暗示影响主要的总体结论,同时保留其个别结果以提高透明度。

blocks.en: 5.5 Robustness across Measures
blocks.zh: 5.5 跨措施的力度

blocks.en: Figure 4 d shows that the three robustness measures induce different judge orderings. kimi-k2.5 ranks first on invariance and agreement but third on stability, whereas gemini-3.5 moves from fifth on invariance to first on stability. Across adjacent measure pairs, 8 of 20 judge orderings reverse, compared with 10 under the unrelated-measure reference. These differences indicate that invariance, agreement, and stability capture distinct aspects of judge behavior rather than interchangeable estimates of a single robustness quantity. A single aggregate score would therefore obscure which failure mode is responsible for a judge’s apparent weakness. Appendix D reports the exact rankings and alternative summaries.
blocks.zh: 图4d显示,三项稳健措施引起不同的法官订单。 Kimi-k2.5在变化和协议方面排名第一,在稳定方面排名第三,而Gemini-3.5则从变化的第五到稳定方面排名第一。 20名法官中有8名对相邻措施进行反向排序,而10名法官则在不相关措施项下进行反向排序。 这些差异表明,变化、一致和稳定性捕捉法官行为的不同方面,而不是对单一强性数量的可互换估计。 因此,单一的汇总得分会模糊哪些失败模式是法官明显软弱的原因。 附 录 D报告了确切的排名和备选摘要。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced EditJudgeBias to test how image-editing judges respond to controlled cues that are designed to preserve the underlying edit. Across the five primary judges, such cues can shift both ratings and pairwise preferences beyond ordinary response variability. Human agreement does not fully predict this behavior: display-order swaps can reverse preferences, and the same judges rank differently on invariance, agreement, and stability.
More broadly, our findings suggest that judge reliability should not be defined solely by whether a judge agrees with humans, but also by whether its decisions remain invariant when the underlying quality being evaluated is unchanged. This offers an insight for MLLM-based evaluation: reliable judging requires measuring the intended construct rather than responding to incidental features of how that construct is presented.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Edit JudgeBias,以测试图像编辑法官如何响应旨在保存基本编辑的受控提示. 在五个主要法官中,这种提示可以改变评级和对等偏好,超越一般的反应可变性。 人类协议并没有完全预测这种行为:显示-顺序互换可以逆转偏好,同样的法官在偏好,同意和稳定性上排名不同.
更广泛地说,我们的调查结果表明,法官的可靠性不应仅仅以法官是否同意人类来界定,还应以法官在评价的基本质量保持不变时其决定是否保持不变来界定。 这为基于MLLM的评价提供了深刻的见解:可靠的判断需要测量预期的构造,而不是应对这种构造如何呈现的附带特征。

blocks.en: AI Disclosure
blocks.zh: AI 披露

blocks.en: Generative AI tools assisted with drafting and language editing, figure preparation, and software tasks including code review and repository maintenance. The research questions, literature selection, experimental design and deployment, data analysis, and interpretation were carried out by the authors.
blocks.zh: Generative AI工具协助起草和语言编辑、数字编制和软件任务,包括代码审查和存储器维护。 提交人进行了研究问题、文献选择、实验设计和部署、数据分析和解释。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: EditJudgeBias uses existing published image-editing benchmarks and controlled interventions intended to audit automated evaluators. Image-side cues are checked for preservation, and human annotation is used only for this purpose. Some prompt-side cues deliberately present fabricated social information, such as a claimed majority preference, to test susceptibility to information irrelevant to editing quality. These statements are confined to the evaluation protocol and are not treated as factual benchmark annotations.
blocks.zh: 编辑法官Bias使用已公布的图像编辑基准和旨在审计自动化评价员的控制干预措施。 图像侧提示被检查保存,人类注释只用于此目的. 一些即时提示有意提供捏造的社会信息,如声称的多数偏好,以测试与编辑质量无关的信息的易感性。 这些陈述仅限于评价协议,不被视为事实基准说明。

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en: We provide an open-source repository at reproducibility repository . This release contains code, configurations, prompts, and scripts, but excludes benchmark images, human annotation records, and experimental judge/validator responses. The author-generated I2EBench outputs used in our experiments are also not included. The release therefore does not by itself permit exact reconstruction of all evaluated inputs or reported results.
blocks.zh: 我们提供一个开源存储器 在可复制存储器。 这个发布包含代码,配置,提示和脚本,但不包括基准图像,人类注释记录,以及实验判断/验证员的响应. 我们实验中使用的作者产生的I2EBench输出也未列入. 因此,这种公布本身并不允许准确重建所有评估的投入或报告的结果。

blocks.en: Several judges are accessed through external APIs, so repeated identical calls may produce different outputs. Our design explicitly accounts for this variability using judge-specific re-query baselines, sham controls, paired inference, confidence intervals, multiple-testing correction, and a separately analyzed replication arm. Reproducibility therefore concerns the statistical findings and qualitative conclusions under expected API variability rather than exact reproduction of every model response.
blocks.zh: 几位法官通过外部API访问,所以重复的同声调可能会产生不同的产出. 我们的设计明确说明了这种可变性,使用了法官特有的再平衡基线、假控制、对等推论、置信间隔、多测试校正以及单独分析的复制臂。 因此,可复制性涉及预期的API可变性的统计结果和定性结论,而不是准确复制每个模型答复。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en:
Our study has three limitations. First, EditJudgeBias evaluates a finite set of controlled cues at specified intervention strengths; interactions among co-occurring cues and responses across a broader range of strengths remain to be characterized. Second, the results reflect the evaluated judge versions and configurations. As models and API services evolve, effect magnitudes and relative judge rankings may change, motivating periodic re-evaluation with the same audit protocol. Third, our experiments focus on diagnosing cue sensitivity, while mitigation is explored only through limited aggregation analyses and a preliminary prompting pilot. Developing and systematically evaluating mitigation strategies under the main experimental protocol remains future work.
Our preservation checks focus on the requested edit; rubric-aligned human ratings of both versions are needed to distinguish evaluator bias from legitimate visual-quality or detail-preservation penalties.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究有三个局限性。 首先, 编辑法官Bias根据特定干预优势评价一套有限的控制提示;共同发生的提示与更广泛的优势的反应之间的相互作用仍有待定性。 第二,结果反映了经评价的法官版本和配置。 随着模型和API服务的发展,影响规模和相对法官的排名可能会发生变化,从而促使定期以同样的审计规程重新评价。 第三,我们的实验侧重于诊断提示灵敏度,而减缓只是通过有限的汇总分析和初步的提示试验加以探索。 根据主要试验议定书制定和系统评估缓解战略仍然是今后的工作。
我们的保存检查侧重于请求的编辑;需要将两种版本的标注式人类评级区分为评价者偏见和合法的视觉质量或细节保护处罚。

blocks.en: Appendix B Benchmark and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录B 基准和评价议定书

blocks.en: B.1 Editing samples and pools
blocks.zh: B.1 编辑样本和集合

blocks.en: The judged subset contains 1,196 samples drawn from five published editing benchmarks. These benchmarks represent three independent content pools rather than five: the rated ImagenHub images are a subset of the MagicBrush development set, and most GenAI-Bench editing prompts come from the same pool. Figure 2 b marks the benchmarks that share underlying content.
blocks.zh: 判断出来的子集包含取自五个已公布的编辑基准的1,196个样本. 这些基准代表了三个独立的内容池而不是五个:被评为ImbnHub的图像是MagicBrush开发集的子集,大多数GenAI-Bench编辑提示来自同个池. 图2b是具有基本内容的基准。

blocks.en: The subset is divided into one breadth block and two anchor blocks. The breadth block contains 611 samples stratified by source and edit type and is used for the invariance analysis. The anchor blocks retain complete editing turns, keeping multiple editors’ outputs for each source–instruction pair together. EBench-18K contributes 48 turns with 8 of the block’s 17 editors, for 384 samples; ImagenHub contributes 30 turns with 8 editors, for 240 samples. These blocks provide the human labels used in the agreement analysis and are also the blocks on which we re-score editor leaderboards. Across these blocks there are 1,235 sample assignments; 39 triplets occur in both the breadth and anchor blocks, yielding 1,196 unique triplets overall. The pairwise protocol uses 616 pairs of edits for the same request, drawn from 1,086 edited images; 438 pairs have a decisive human preference.
blocks.zh: 子集分为一宽块和二锚块. 宽块包含611个样本,按来源和编辑类型进行分级,并被用来进行变相分析. 锚块保留完整的编辑转盘,使每个源的多个编辑器输出组合在一起。 EBench-18K为384个样本提供了48个转弯,其中8个为区块的17个编辑;ImynHub为30个转弯,8个为编辑,240个为样本。 这些块提供了协议分析中使用的人类标签,也是我们重排编辑前导板的块. 在这些区块中,共有1 235个抽样任务;39个三胞胎既出现在宽地块中,也出现在锚地块中,总共产生了1 196个独特的三胞胎。 双相协议为同一请求使用616对编辑,取自1,086被编辑的图像;438对具有决定性的人类偏好.

blocks.en: B.2 Cues, operators and doses
blocks.zh: B.2 Cues、操作人员和剂量

blocks.en: All image-side cues are deterministic PIL operations applied after the edit has been produced. For the global pixel-site cues, saturation and brightness scale the corresponding enhancement by 1.2. The aesthetic filter increases contrast by 1.1, shifts the red and blue channels by + 8 +8 and − 8 -8 points for a warm cast, and applies an unsharp mask at 60% with radius 1/256 of the frame. padding adds a black border equal to 10% of each image dimension on every side. watermark places “Reference Image” in the bottom-right corner at 45% opacity, using a font size of 4% of the short edge and a 3% inset. text overlay places a salient word from the instruction in a semi-transparent band along the top edge at 50% opacity, with a font size of 5% of the short edge.
blocks.zh: 所有图像侧提示都是在编辑完成后应用的决定性PIL操作. 对于全球像素-站点,饱和度和亮度以1.2相标出相应的增强. 美学滤波器增加了1.1的对比度,以+8+8和−8-8的分来改变红色和蓝色的通道来取暖铸造,并在60%的半径为1/256的帧上应用了无尖口罩. padding 添加一个黑色边框, 等于每边图像尺寸的10% 。 水印将“参考图像”置于右下角45%的不透明度,使用短边缘4%的字体和3%的内置字体。 文本上方将指示中突出的单词放在上边半透明的带中,为50%不透明,字体大小为5%的短边。

blocks.en: The four content-site cues are defined relative to the edit region. box draws a red rectangle around the region with a stroke width of 3/512 of the frame. inset crops and magnifies the region by 2 × 2\times , caps its side length at 40% of the frame, and places it in a corner with a 3/512 white border. caption prints “Edited: {instruction}”, truncated to 14 words, in a white bar with near-black text at a font size of 3.5% of the short edge. sticker places an unrelated element covering at most 4% of the frame area outside the edit region, inset by 2%. The zero-dose sham control is a JPEG round trip at quality 95.
blocks.zh: 四个内容站点是相对于编辑区域定义的. 框中绘制一个红色矩形,框的中风宽为3/512。 将作物套入并放大2×2\times 的区域,将它的侧长以框架的40%为上限,并用3/512的白色边框将其置于一角. 标题打印出“已编辑 : { instruction} ” , 缩写为 14 个字, 以字体大小为短边3.5%的近黑文字的白色栏目。 标签将一个不相关的元素放置在编辑区域以外的框架区域最多占4%,被设置为2%。 零剂量假冒控制是一次JPEG往返于质量95.

blocks.en: The prompt-site cues leave the image unchanged. In scoring, bandwagon appends “Note: previous reviewers rated this edit very highly.” to the judge prompt, while model name adds “This edited image was produced by the {model} model.” using the generator label recorded for the edit in its source dataset. In pairwise evaluation, the bandwagon message becomes “Note: 90% of human evaluators preferred Image {A | | B}.”, with the claimed majority assigned to a seeded side so that it does not systematically favor slot A; the model-name cue names both candidates. The protocol-site cue position simply swaps the display order of the pair, changing neither the image pixels nor the prompt text.
blocks.zh: 即时站点提示让图像保持不变. 在评分中, Bandwagon 附录“注:前审查人员对这个编辑的评价非常高。” “这个经编辑的图像是由{model}模型所制作的。” 使用源数据集中记录的用于编辑的生成器标签。 在双向评价中,带宽信息变为“注:90%的人类评估人员更喜欢图像{A } { { B } , 声称的多数被分配到种子一侧,以便它不会系统地偏好插槽A;模型名称提示两个候选人的名字。 协议站点位置只是交换对子的显示顺序,既不改变图像像素,也不改变即时文本.

blocks.en: B.3 The edit region
blocks.zh: B.3 联合国 编辑区域

blocks.en: The four content-site cues require an estimate of the edit region. We use the benchmark-provided source mask when available. Otherwise, we threshold the per-channel difference between the source and edited images at 15 out of 255 and take the largest connected component, falling back to a centered box if no component is found. box and inset operate directly on this region; sticker is placed away from it, while caption uses the region only to avoid covering the edit.
blocks.zh: 四个内容站点需要编辑区域的估计. 我们使用基准提供的源口罩。 否则,我们以255分之15对源和被编辑的图像的每道相差进行阈值,并取出最大的相接组件,如果找不到组件,会倒回中框. 框和套接字直接在这个区域上操作;贴纸被放在它之外,而标题只用这个区域来避免覆盖编辑。

blocks.en: B.4 Judges, rubrics and collection
blocks.zh: B.4 法官、笔名和收藏

blocks.en: In the scoring protocol, each judge receives the source image, editing instruction, and edited image and returns one integer from 1 to 10 for instruction adherence, editing quality, and detail preservation. Their sum gives the 3–30 score used in the analysis. We request temperature 0 whenever this parameter is configurable; gpt-5.5 uses the provider-fixed setting. Retest noise is estimated by re-querying each judge on 200 un-cued items. VIEScore uses its original rubric with GPT-4o as the underlying model rather than constituting a separate model family.

blocks.en: C.1 Validator Calibration and Results

blocks.en: The preservation gate is evaluated independently of scoring and pairwise judging. Each validator receives the source image, instruction, edited image, and cued edited image, and checks whether the cue changes instruction adherence, editing quality, detail preservation, or scene semantics; a sample passes only when all four answers are no. We evaluate each validator on 110 images per cue, with 780 sham images used to estimate its baseline flag rate. Gemini-3.5 and gpt-4o-mini, which have the lower sham flag rates, form the gate, while glm-4v serves as an independent cross-check. Table 2 reports the cue-level pass rates and calibration against controlled degradations.

blocks.en: Against paired sham images, inset is the only cue with a significantly lower pass rate after Benjamini–Hochberg correction: the difference is detected by gemini-3.5 ( q = 0.020 q=0.020 ) and glm-4v ( q < 0.001 q<0.001 ), but not by gpt-4o-mini. A disjoint repeat over seven cues yields the same qualitative pattern. Gemini-3.5 again differs from sham only for inset , with a pass rate of 87.3% versus 100.0% ( q < 0.001 q<0.001 ), while gpt-4o-mini shows no significant difference for any repeated cue.

blocks.en: The controlled degradations clarify what each validator detects. Gemini-3.5 becomes increasingly sensitive as more of the edit region is reverted toward the source, whereas gpt-4o-mini detects edit-region blur but rarely flags reversion (Table 2 , Panel B). The two validators are therefore not equally informative about instruction-adherence preservation, and requiring both to pass provides limited additional evidence beyond the primary validator on this dimension.
blocks.zh: 控制的降解澄清了每个验证器检测到的. Gpt-4o-mini检测到编辑区域模糊而很少出现旗帜回转(表2,B小组)。 因此,两个验证人对遵守指示的保全没有同样的信息,要求双方通过,除了主要验证人之外,在这方面提供有限的额外证据。

blocks.en: C.2 Human Verification
blocks.zh: C.2 人类核查

blocks.en: We also assess preservation through human annotation, with 30 examples for each of the ten image-side cues. The first annotation package covers five pixel-site cues; the second covers four content-site cues and one pixel-site cue together with sham controls, with cue identities hidden until annotation is complete. Annotators label each intervention as changing the underlying edit by No, Slightly, or Yes, with only Yes prespecified as a preservation failure.
blocks.zh: 我们还通过人类注释来评估保存情况,10个图像旁提示中每个提示都有30个实例。 第一个注解包包括五个像素-站点;第二个包包括四个内容-站点和一个像素-站点,加上假名控制,在注解完成前隐藏出提示身份. 注释者将每次干预标注为以 No, Slightly, 或yes 更改基本编辑, 仅将"是"预设为保存失败.

blocks.en: Under this criterion, none of the five cues in the sham-controlled package differs significantly from sham : the inset has 2/30 failures versus 0/30 for sham , while the other four cues have none. A post-hoc criterion that also counts Slightly as a failure changes the conclusion only for the inset, with 11/30 failures versus 0/30 for sham ( q = 0.002 q=0.002 ). A second annotator independently labels 60 items from this package, yielding 98.3% raw agreement and Cohen’s κ = 0.893 \kappa=0.893 . The annotators were aware of the study hypothesis.

blocks.en: C.3 Sensitivity Analysis on Validated Images
blocks.zh: C.3 验证图像的敏感性分析

blocks.en: As a separate sensitivity analysis, we repeat the breadth analysis using only images that pass both gating validators, leaving 47–57 items per cue–judge cell. All 24 effects that are significant in both the full and filtered analyses retain the same direction. We therefore use this analysis only as a check on effect direction within the validated subset, rather than as a second estimate of effect magnitude or evidence of preservation for every image.
blocks.zh: 作为单独的灵敏度分析,我们只使用通过两个示意图验证器的图像来重复广度分析,每个示意图的判断单元格留下47-57个项目。 在全面分析和过滤分析中都具有重要意义的所有24个影响都保持同样的方向。 因此,我们仅将这一分析用作对经验证的子集内效果方向的检查,而不是对效果大小的第二次估计或每一图像保存的证据。

blocks.en: The following analyses test whether the main effects can be attributed to narrower features of the evaluation set. If the photometric results arise mainly because a cue repeats or conflicts with the requested edit, they should weaken once such instruction–cue collisions are removed (Table 7 ). Likewise, effects driven primarily by poor edits should attenuate among outputs with the highest human mean-opinion scores (Table 8 ). We also examine the four cues shared by both anchor benchmarks to distinguish benchmark-specific changes in human agreement from patterns that recur across anchors (Table 9 ).

blocks.en: E.2 Downstream Consequences and Aggregation

blocks.en: We next ask whether cue-induced shifts remain consequential after scores are converted into downstream decisions. For leaderboard evaluation, we apply a cue to one editor at a time while leaving the other entrants unchanged, isolating a single-entrant setting in which only one system carries the cue (Table 10 ). We then examine two common forms of aggregation: reconciling the two presentation orders in pairwise judging (Table 11 ) and combining scores across judges with a standardized median (Table 12 ).

Thus, a cue that shifts individual scores can alter leaderboard conclusions, but the downstream effect depends on the benchmark and editor pool.
